review_notes: I read the whole file, which holds one theorem. I also grepped the repo for the same sign-extension pattern in sibling Sol files. Those files (for example the `exists_d_zero_eq_unitPullback_sub...` one) use a different structure, so I found no cross-file duplicate of this proof. The only real repetition is inside the `Z_cocy` proof, where five branches share one argument. Z_smul and Z_nat, the u''/θF'' computations and the final hinv/hlt branch are short or not really duplicated, so I did not flag them. The proposed `Z_anti` factoring is untested. Dependent types such as `⟨W.1, hj⟩` and the `Z_lt`/`Z_gt` rewrites might need adjustment, and the gain is moderate.

findings.problem: Z_cocy extends the ordered cocycle identity hzCc from i<j<l to all triples by a 3x3 trichotomy tree. Five of the leaves (lines ~151, 156, 162, 167, 171) repeat the same argument. They rewrite with Z_lt/Z_gt and LinearMap.neg_apply, instantiate hzCc at a permutation of (i,j,l), then close with `rw [← this]; abel`. Only the permutation and the neg_apply bookkeeping differ. The proof therefore reproves 'hzCc plus antisymmetry gives the cocycle identity for each of the six permutations' several times, and each branch needs its own hand-written index and hypothesis arguments (`⟨W.1, hl⟩ W.2 hj`, etc.). Antisymmetry of Z is never stated as a lemma. The only trace of it is the ad-hoc `hz` inside the last branch (line ~256), which has to go through Z_cocy itself.
findings.proposed_change: Prove a small antisymmetry lemma first, `Z_anti : ∀ i j W hj v, Z i j W hj v + Z j i ⟨W.1, hj⟩ W.2 v = 0`. A trichotomy on i,j with Z_lt/Z_gt/Z_self proves it. Then prove a single normal-form lemma for strictly ordered triples, `Z_ord : i<j → j<l → Z i j W hj v + Z j l ⟨W.1,hj⟩ hl v = Z i l W hl v`. This is exactly hzCc with Z_lt rewritten. Z_cocy then becomes a trichotomy over the order of (i,j,l). Each of the six strict permutations is closed by `Z_ord` at the sorted triple, plus `Z_anti` on the reversed pairs, plus `abel` or `eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero`. The degenerate cases i=j, j=l, i=l still reduce through Z_self. The `hz` step in the final branch (line ~256) would reuse Z_anti directly, not Z_cocy.
findings.benefit: The sign and orientation reasoning is stated once, as antisymmetry plus the ordered cocycle, instead of being re-derived in five branches with fragile positional arguments. The proof is easier to audit and shorter, and a change to the zC/Z conventions would be fixed in two lemmas, not in every branch.
